meta.description: Anonymized from a real aSc timetable export. Teacher and class names are generated; structure, subjects and rooms are real.
assumptions: Class codes 22x..26x mapped to grades 8..12; last digit = parallel letter.
Room 'СБ' is the sports hall and holds several PE lessons at once.
Rooms 'STEMn' are labs; numbered rooms are regular classrooms.
'Първа група'/'Втора група' and language names are group labels as printed.
known_quirks: Some practice (УП) slots list both groups of a class in two different lessons at once (e.g. ИТ + Ув.прог); how groups rotate is unknown.
PE teachers have overlapping blocks with different classes in 'СБ'.
Several lessons are joint across classes (languages, PE, some ТП lectures).
